title: Quantitative homogenization of convex Hamilton-Jacobi equations in the Wasserstein space
summary: We study a homogenization problem for first-order Hamilton-Jacobi equations in the Wasserstein space with a convex Hamiltonian. We show that the solution $U^\varepsilon$, which is the value function of a mean field control problem, converges uniformly as $\varepsilon \to 0$ to the solution of a limiting Hamilton-Jacobi equation whose Hamiltonian is obtained through a suitable cell problem. Furthermore, we establish quantitative rates of convergence. Under general assumptions with multiscale dependence, we prove that the rate of convergence is $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$.
